args.message:
round_money: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP although the docstring (and
FIN-212) call for banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-way amounts round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).
Fixes the nightly failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- Switched to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-way amounts round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).
- This fixes the nightly failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.
